### **Description**

  

Infor is seeking an Associate Software Engineer who is passionate about developing high\-quality, scalable software solutions. You will work closely with senior engineers, product managers, and designers to deliver products that drive business value for our customers. This role is ideal for early\-career engineers who thrive in collaborative, agile environments and are eager to grow technical and leadership skills.### **A Typical Day in the Life Includes:**

  

* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to design, develop, test, and deliver software features aligned with business needs.
* Write clean, scalable, and maintainable code following best practices and Infor development standards.
* Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and daily stand\-ups to ensure software quality and share knowledge.
* Troubleshoot and resolve software defects and other technical issues.
* Continuously learn and apply emerging technologies to improve product performance and reliability.
* Support deployment activities and maintain the health of production environments.
* Document technical decisions, processes, and best practices to contribute to knowledge sharing across the team.

* Experience in one or more programming languages (e.g., Java, C\#, Python, JavaScript).
* Experience of software engineering principles, algorithms, and data structures.
* Experience with RESTful APIs, cloud technologies, and relational databases.

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Experience with Agile/Scrum development methodologies.
* Experience of modern UI frameworks (e.g., Angular, React, Vue). Experience of DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines.

jobs.description:
**Shape the Future with Dun \& Bradstreet**
At Dun \& Bradstreet, we believe data has the power to create a better tomorrow. As a global leader in business decisioning data and analytics, we help companies worldwide grow, manage risk, and innovate. For over 180 years, businesses have trusted us to turn uncertainty into opportunity. We’re a diverse, global team that values creativity, collaboration, and bold ideas. Are you ready to make an impact and help shape what’s next? Join us! Explore opportunities at dnb.com/careers. **The Role:** We are seeking a highly skilled Full Stack Engineer to design, develop, and scale next\-generation Data Quality and AI\-enabled platforms. In this role, you will work across the entire technology stack—from intuitive user experiences and data visualizations to cloud\-native backend services and data processing pipelines. You will partner closely with Data Quality SMEs, Data Engineers, Product Managers, Data Scientists, and Platform Teams to build solutions that support data observability, analytics, data governance, and AI\-driven insights.



You will help build the next generation of D\&B's Data Quality Insights platform, enabling data governance, observability, analytics, and AI\-powered decision support for enterprise data products.



### **Key Responsibilities:**


**Full stack Application Development**

* Design and develop modern, responsive web applications and drive the end\-to\-end development of scalable full\-stack solutions using React, TypeScript, and Python (FastAPI), delivering high\-performance web applications, APIs, microservices, analytics dashboards, data platform integrations, and AI\-powered capabilities in partnership with Product, Data Engineering, Architecture, and Platform teams.


**Data Quality \& Analytics**


* Build and enhance next\-generation Data Quality and Governance platform that enables rule management, observability, metadata\-driven monitoring, policy enforcement, and AI\-powered insights. Develop scalable capabilities (front\-end and back\-end) for data quality assessment, anomaly detection, lineage, governance workflows, and self\-service analytics, transforming business requirements into extensible enterprise\-grade solutions.


**Cloud Engineering \& DevOps**


* Build cloud\-native applications using GCP. Containerize applications using GKE and orchestrate deployments through CI/CD pipelines, preferably Terraform. Implement Infrastructure\-as\-Code and engineering best practices. Participate in operational excellence activities, monitoring, reliability, and platform optimization.


**AI \& automation**


* Integrate Generative AI and Agentic AI capabilities into engineering solutions. Collaborate with Data Scientists and AI teams to operationalize AI/ML models. Develop AI\-powered workflows, anomaly detection solutions, and intelligent user experiences. Build and integrate LLM\-enabled services, copilots, and automation capabilities where appropriate.


**Engineering Governance**


* Write clean, maintainable, and testable code. Develop automated unit, integration, and end\-to\-end tests. Perform code reviews, technical documentation and contribute to engineering standards and best practices. Champion security, scalability, performance, and accessibility standards. Participate in architectural discussions and comply to Agile/Scrum practices.
### **Key Requirements:**


* 5\-8 years of professional full‑stack/software engineering development experience with demonstrated ownership of end‑to‑end systems.
* Strong experience in modern frontend development using React/Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6\+), HTML5/CSS3
* Strong backend development experience using Python, FastAPI or Flask
* Strong SQL skills with experience developing analytical queries against large\-scale datasets.
* Experience designing and developing REST APIs, Microservices architectures, Event\-driven systems
* Experience with databases PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB or equivalent NoSQL technologies
* Experience with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, Terraform, Git\-based development workflows
* Experience building and deploying applications on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) including BigQuery, Composer (Airflow), Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, Dataproc, Dataflow and GKE. Experience with Terraform and Infrastructure\-as\-Code is highly preferred.
* Strong testing fundamentals across the stack (unit, integration, E2E).
* Solid understanding of Git workflows and development tooling (npm/yarn etc).
* Familiarity with data pipelines, ETL/ELT processing, metadata\-driven architectures, observability frameworks, and large\-scale analytical platforms.
* Strong grounding in web security, including authentication, authorization, and secure API communication.
* Strong problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work independently and in cross\-functional teams.
* Focus on quality, performance, and maintainability.
This position internally titles as Software Engineer II

You will be responsible for transforming data into actionable insights that drive product strategy, customer experience, and business growth. * Analyze customer and product behavior across our manufacturing service lines and eCommerce platform to identify opportunities for growth and operational improvement.
* Partner with Product Managers to understand customer journeys, product adoption, conversion funnels, and business performance.
* Proactively explore datasets to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and business opportunities.
* Translate complex analytical findings into clear recommendations that support product strategy and business decisions.
* Help product teams understand the "why" behind performance metrics and customer behavior.

jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program management.
* Experience leading technical discussions and plans.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 8 years of experience in technical program management with emerging technologies.
* 5 years of experience managing cross\-functional or cross\-team projects.
* Ability to own and deliver complex, cross\-functional technical programs end\-to\-end.
* Excellent ability to influence without authority and drive consensus across engineering, product, and UX.
* Exceptional communication skills, articulating complex topics to technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Skilled in navigating ambiguity, proactively identifying and mitigating risks, and managing dependencies.

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.


In gTech Users and Products (gUP), our mission is to advocate for Google’s users by creating helpful and trusted experiences across the product ecosystem.


As a Technical Program Manager (TPM) in the gUP TSI Program Management Office (PMO), you will lead and drive the execution of complex, cross\-functional programs critical to gUP's top priorities. You will take ownership of significant initiatives, potentially spanning areas like the Generative AI\-powered help guide, enhancing User Voice feedback systems, or refining engineering operations and governance frameworks.


You will collaborate closely with Engineering, Product Management, and UX teams to define program scope, develop detailed execution plans, manage dependencies, mitigate risks, and ensure on\-time delivery. This role requires a strong ability to manage ambiguity, influence stakeholders without direct authority, and make sound technical judgments. You will be responsible for driving alignment across teams, communicating progress effectively, and proactively solving problems to keep high\-impact programs on track. We are looking for an experienced TPM who can operate independently and contribute to improving program management practices within TSI.


In gTech Users and Products (gUP), our mission is to advocate for Google’s users by creating helpful and trusted experiences across the product ecosystem. We achieve this by meeting partners and consumers where they are with support and help, representing their needs with our product partners and proposing fixes and features that elevate their engagement with Google's diverse product ecosystem. Additionally we provide a range of product services that ensure our products are optimized for every user, no matter where they are in the world (e.g., localization, digitization, partner integration and more).

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Drive and own the delivery of complex, high\-impact programs, from technical scoping and design through global launch, landing, and maintenance.
* Apply deep technical understanding to proactively identify and resolve complex system\-level blockers, guiding technical decisions within Generative AI architecture, prompt engineering, and data pipelines.
* Influence and align cross\-functional teams (Engineering, Product, UX) and stakeholders on program goals, technical approaches, and priorities, driving consensus and unblocking progress.
* Contribute to product and program strategy by identifying opportunities, defining clear project goals, and ensuring alignment with broader gUP objectives.
* Design, implement, and drive adoption of scalable frameworks, best practices, and data\-driven OKRs to improve program execution, monitor health, and enhance communication with leadership.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager, Specialist
jobs.description:
Leads the strategic vision and roadmap for a technical product, demonstrating an understanding of the product(s) and associated business areas. Products often have divisional implications.
   

  

**About Vanguard**
 Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
   

  

******Vanguard’s India Office******
 Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud\-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world\-class experience for our clients.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 This role leads the strategic vision and roadmap for a technical product, demonstrating an understanding of the product(s) and associated business areas. Products often have divisional implications. This role also leverages market research and user feedback to influence product direction, innovation, and enhancements throughout the product life cycle.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Provides technical product management services on a product, applying functional technical expertise to improve product results. Participates in the design and continuous improvement of the technical solution.
* Coaches technical product teams towards best practices and learnings. Ensures delivery of messaging, communication, and customer outreach as necessary.
* Partners with stakeholders to resolve production and implementation issues in a timely manner, and supports/drives escalations where required to enable rapid delivery.
* Leads the planning, development and implementation of a new technical product. Defines and analyzes technical markets, developing detailed product features and requirements, and developing implementation plans.
* Employs a variety of qualitative and quantitative analysis techniques to continually improve the user experience.
* Participates in and provides recommendations for ongoing business planning and departmental prioritization activities.
* Participates in the team’s engineering practices in development, continuous integration, and automated deployment.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Manages the entire product life cycle from planning to execution in alignment with organizational strategy and objectives.
* Conducts market research and analyzes consumer trends to identify opportunities for product innovation and enhancement.
* Collaborates with cross\-functional teams to define product features and functions and supports product development execution.
* Prepares detailed product documentation and provides technical support to sales and marketing teams.
* Gathers and incorporates market feedback to evaluate and steer current and future product functionality.


**Qualifications And Skills**
* Minimum 5 years of experience in technical product management or related roles, with 2 years of experience managing projects preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of training and experience.
* Must have: Appian platform knowledge (other similar platform like Camunda), backlog management, requirements elicitation and definition, Agile / Scrum product ownership, JIRA/Confluence, Roadmap planning.
* Nice to have: Process mapping, stakeholder management, user story writing, testing / UAT coordination, market research and user feedback analysis, product documentation, stakeholder communication.
* Strong verbal and written communication, collaboration, critical thinking, and problem\-solving, Learning Agility abilities.
* Preferred certifications include Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), Pragmatic Institute certifications, or SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager. Financial Services or function\-specific experience is an added advantage.


******Location******
 This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard’s India office. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
   

  

******Our mission******
 Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
   

  

******Our commitment to you******
 Vanguard takes the same long\-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
   

  

******Financial wellness******
 We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
   

  

******Physical wellness******
 We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
   

  

******Personal wellness******
 We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
   

  

******How we work******
 Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in\-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission\-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long\-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Business Platforms, Sales and Support
jobs.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in product management or related technical role.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* 10 years of experience with enterprise product management.
* Experience working in a cross\-functional organization and influencing engineers, product managers, or senior executives.
* Engineering or technical experience shipping technical products.
* Strong product management, business acumen, analytical, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong problem\-solving, data analysis skills and articulate business judgment.


**About the job** 
 At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
   

  

 In this role, you will work cross\-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.
   

  

 One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world\-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.
   

  

 In this role, you will bring the experience, passion, and drive to envision and deliver great user experiences, great platform services, and meaningful impact to customers' businesses. As a part of this role, you will help radically transform what users expect of a contact center through agentic capabilities, insights, ML\-based automation, and platform capabilities. As a part of this role, you will need to go past the obvious, be unafraid to hold an opinion on strategy and direction, and bring the tenacity and conviction to turn into reality. In this role, you will need to be a learner, curious, and articulate someone who is aspirational, bold, and transformative, yet practical and impact focused.The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. **Partner \& API Integrations** 



* Build and enhance integrations with accounting/payroll software and enterprise APIs to facilitate large\-scale tax reporting operations.



  





**Performance Monitoring \& Optimization** 



* Track product metrics such as error rates, filing volume trends, and customer satisfaction.
* Use insights to optimize feature performance and ensure scalability during peak tax seasons
 **.**



**Go\-to\-Market \& Documentation** 



* Work with marketing and documentation teams to communicate new features, regulatory updates, and filing season enhancements to customers.

 years of product management experience in SaaS, fintech, or regulatory compliance domains. Prior work with tax software or IRS\-integrated products is a strong plus.

 Ability to translate customer needs into actionable product requirements and ensure a seamless user experience.
* **Analytical Skills:** 
 Strong ability to analyze data, monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), and leverage insights to drive product decisions.

 Ability to identify pain points in the payments process and design innovative solutions to address them.
* **Communication Skills:** 
 Excellent communication skills to effectively collaborate with internal teams and external stakeholders.







**Why Join the Tax1099 Team** 



* Mission\-Driven Impact: Help thousands of businesses stay compliant with federal and state tax laws with less friction and more automation.

**Role Summary**


The Senior Data Engineer is responsible for building, assessing, and strengthening the **data foundations** that support **Platinum‑level enterprise data sources**. This role works in close partnership with Data Operations Analysts to operationalize data specifications, implement lineage and observability capabilities, and ensure critical enterprise data assets are reliable, transparent, and governed.


A key component of this role is **engineering integrations between Platinum data products and enterprise data governance platforms (e.g., Collibra)** to automate lineage, technical metadata, and observability signals across the data ecosystem.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Platinum Data Foundation Engineering**

* Partner with Data Operations Analysts to perform **data foundation assessments** for Platinum data sources, evaluating:
	+ Source system readiness and integration patterns
	+ Data model structure and reuse potential
	+ Reliability, scalability, and quality controls
* Design, build, and maintain **enterprise‑grade data pipelines** that support certified data products.
* Ensure Platinum sources meet standards for **performance, availability, and operational resilience**.

**Data Lineage, Governance \& Architecture Enablement**

* Implement and maintain **end‑to‑end technical data lineage** from source systems through Databricks and downstream consumption layers.
* **Build and maintain integrations between data products and enterprise data governance tools (e.g., Collibra)** to:
	+ Publish technical metadata and lineage
	+ Associate data assets with governed business metadata
	+ Enable automated certification and impact analysis workflows
* Partner with DataOps and governance teams to ensure engineered metadata aligns with enterprise standards and stewardship processes.

**Data Observability \& Reliability**

* Design and implement **automated data observability and reliability reporting** for Platinum data sources, including:
	+ Freshness, volume, and anomaly tracking
	+ Pipeline health and dependency monitoring
	+ SLA and reliability indicators
* Integrate observability outputs into governance and metadata platforms where appropriate to support transparency and auditability.
* Proactively identify and remediate data quality and operational issues.

**Databricks \& Enterprise Data Integration**

* Build and optimize pipelines and transformations within **Databricks**, following best practices for performance, cost, and scalability.
* Connect and integrate data across **Databricks and other enterprise data platforms**, including warehouses, lakehouses, and operational data stores.
* Support the creation of **curated, reusable data layers** aligned to Platinum data product definitions and certified metrics.

**Cross‑Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with Data Operations Analysts to translate **data specifications, lineage requirements, and business metadata** into engineered solutions.
* Partner with analytics teams to ensure Platinum data assets are fit for reporting, metrics, and advanced analytics.
* Collaborate with platform, architecture, and governance teams to ensure enterprise standards are consistently implemented.

**Required Qualifications**

* **5–8 years of experience** in data engineering or analytics engineering roles.
* Strong hands‑on experience with **Databricks** and modern lakehouse architectures.
* Proven experience building **enterprise‑grade data pipelines** and integrations.
* Demonstrated experience implementing:
	+ **Technical lineage and metadata publishing**
	+ **Integrations between data platforms and data governance tools (preferably Collibra)**
	+ Data observability and reliability controls
* Strong understanding of enterprise data integration and governance patterns.
* Ability to work closely with DataOps, governance, and analytics teams in a matrixed environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting **Platinum / Tier‑0 / certified enterprise data products**.
* Familiarity with Collibra APIs, metadata ingestion frameworks, or lineage automation patterns.
* Experience operationalizing governed data products in regulated or compliance‑driven environments.
* Experience working within a **DataOps or product‑oriented data organization**.

**Key Competencies**

* Data engineering and pipeline architecture
* Lineage and metadata integration engineering
* Observability and reliability enablement
* Governance‑aware solution design
* Cross‑functional collaboration and execution

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst [T500-27573]
jobs.description:
**About Stolt\-Nielsen:** 




 Stolt\-Nielsen is a family\-founded global leader in bulk\-liquid and chemical logistics, transportation, and storage, known for its commitment to safety, service excellence, and innovation. At the Stolt\-Nielsen Digital Innovation Centre, we bring this legacy into the future — building smarter systems, driving digital transformation, and shaping what's next for the world of logistics. Here, you’re encouraged to think boldly, challenge convention, and help move today’s products toward tomorrow’s possibilities.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 The Senior Business Analyst plays a central role in bridging the gap between business stakeholders and technology teams across our terminal operations and logistics domain. Across our businesses, our applications run business\-critical processes — from order to cash, product inventory, and field operations to bulk\-liquid storage, handling, and distribution — and the quality of our requirements and analysis directly determines the success of our delivery.
 



  





 As a Senior BA, your primary focus will be on eliciting, structuring, and validating requirements across complex, multi\-stakeholder programmes. You will work closely with product owners, engineers, and operational business users to translate real\-world challenges into actionable specifications and well\-delivered solutions.
 



  





 We take Digital seriously. We invest in our teams through training and mentoring and enable them with the required tools to work in a modern way. As we are further building up our engineering practice, there is ample room for you to contribute, take initiative and shape the future of our ways of working and technology landscape.
 



  





**What You’ll Do:** 



* Lead requirements gathering workshops with stakeholders across terminal operations, logistics, and enterprise functions to surface objectives, pain points, and solution options.
* Produce high\-quality Business Requirement Specifications (BRS), Functional Specifications, and user stories with clear acceptance criteria in tools such as JIRA or Azure DevOps.
* Act as the primary interface between business users and technology teams — managing ambiguity, resolving gaps, and keeping alignment throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Actively participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives.
* Collaborate with Product Owners to manage and refine the product backlog, supporting timely and prioritized sprint delivery.
* Perform impact analysis for proposed changes or enhancements, identifying gaps, customization requirements, and feasibility risks.
* Participate in System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT), ensuring delivered solutions meet requirements and are production ready.
* Contribute to the design of reports, dashboards, and operational tooling in support of business decision\-making.
* Deliver end\-user training and provide hands\-on go\-live support for new deployments and enhancements.
* Apply domain knowledge of bulk\-liquid terminal operations — including storage, handling, distribution, and maintenance workflows — to challenge requirements and propose fit\-for\-purpose solutions.



  





**What You’ll Bring** 



* Bachelor’s degree in information systems, Business Administration, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience as a Business Analyst, with a strong focus on Shipping, Logistics, or Terminal Management Systems.
* Demonstrated experience delivering full lifecycle business analysis — from discovery and requirements through to UAT and go\-live.
* Strong working knowledge of terminal operations, including storage, depot processes, and maintenance workflows.
* Proven experience in Agile project environments; skilled in writing user stories, acceptance criteria, and managing backlog activities.
* Experience with JIRA, Azure DevOps, or equivalent tools for requirements and backlog management.
* Familiarity with ERP systems and experience in impact analysis and customization scoping.
* Relevant industry certification in shipping, logistics, or enterprise platforms is a strong advantage.



  





**Must Have Skills:** 



* Ability to independently lead complex requirements gathering sessions and produce specification\-grade documentation.
* Confident facilitation of UAT with business users and structured capture of outcomes.
* Experience working across cross\-functional, globally distributed teams in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to translate complex operational situations into clear, workable requirements for technical teams.
* Strong communication skills — equally effective with senior stakeholders and engineering teams.

jobs.title: Product Delivery / Project Manager - Vice President
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

This role is ideal for someone who loves turning ambiguity into action: creating structure, running tight forums, ensuring follow\-through, and helping senior leaders make informed decisions; while working closely with Product, Technology, Decision Science, Design, and 2nd Line / control partners to deliver responsibly.


As a Product Delivery / Project Manager within Consumer \& Community Banking (CCB) Finance AI/ML, you will sit at the center of a high\-impact product organization building AI\-enabled products for CCB CFO stakeholders. You'll drive end\-to\-end governance, delivery execution, and stakeholder alignment so that our AI capabilities move from idea approved use case build launch in a controlled, compliant, and scalable way.

**Job Responsibilities**


Governance \& Controls (end\-to\-end)

* Own and manage project governance from intake through delivery, including required checkpoints, documentation, and stakeholder approvals.
* Partner with Compliance, Legal, Operational Risk, and Controls to coordinate reviews, address questions, and drive timely signoffs.
* Maintain clear decision logs, risk/issue tracking, dependency mapping, and escalation paths so delivery remains audit\-ready and predictable.




Product Delivery Operations (cadence, forums, follow\-ups)

* Schedule and run recurring delivery ceremonies and stakeholder meetings; publish crisp notes, actions, owners, and due dates.
* Establish consistent routines and artifacts for tracking progress, decisions, and outcomes (e.g., scorecards, dashboards, operating trackers).




Executive\-ready communications for Finance leadership

* Gather inputs across teams and convert them into clear, concise materials for Finance senior leadership: status, risks, decisions needed, and narrative on business value.
* Provide executive\-level status reporting, tailored to audience and forum, ensuring transparency and accountability.




Jira ownership (Epics / Stories / delivery hygiene)

* Own Jira hygiene end\-to\-end: creating and maintaining Epics, Stories, prioritization views, delivery dashboards, and reporting.
* Improve team workflows by making Jira the single source of truth for scope, delivery status, and dependencies. (JPM PM roles explicitly call out managing plans/workflows in Jira and improving Jira reporting/processes.)




“Quad” and cross\-functional execution

* Coordinate with core delivery partners (Technology, Decision Science, Design, Product, and control partners) to unblock work, align timelines, and ensure readiness for releases.
* Facilitate collaboration and communication across cross\-functional stakeholders, helping teams move quickly while staying within governance and risk expectations.




Use case intake, triage, and pipeline management across LOBs

* Serve as a front door for AI/ML demand: gather, triage, and structure use cases coming from various CFO organizations and lines of business.
* Maintain intake logs, prioritization frameworks, and roadmap artifacts that align stakeholder demand with capacity and strategic outcomes. (This aligns with JPM program manager language around intake/triage and maintaining operating artifacts.)




**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills**

* 7\+ years of experience in project/program management, product operations, transformation, or delivery management—preferably in financial services or another regulated industry.
* Demonstrated ability to drive work across multiple stakeholders and deliver outcomes in a matrixed organization.
* Strong communication skills with experience producing executive\-ready presentations and running senior stakeholder forums.
* Strong command of Agile delivery fundamentals and tools; especially Jira (and ideally Confluence/SharePoint).
* High attention to detail, excellent follow\-through, and comfort operating with ambiguity.




**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to AI/ML product delivery or technology governance (even if not hands\-on model building).
* Familiarity with concepts like responsible AI, data governance, model lifecycle, or risk/compliance controls in technology delivery (JPM postings commonly highlight AI governance, risk identification/mitigation, and cross\-functional collaboration with Legal/Compliance/Engineering/Design.)
* PMP, CSM, or equivalent Agile/PM certification.




**Why join this team**

* You'll help deliver AI products that directly support how CCB Finance leaders run the business—turning high\-value needs into real capabilities.
* You'll sit at the intersection of Product \+ AI/ML \+ Governance, building the operating muscle that makes innovation scalable and compliant.
* You'll work with a broad set of partners across the firm (Finance, Tech, Data Science, Design, and control functions), giving you visibility and influence well beyond a typical PMO role.


**ABOUT US**  

  

  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

**Who we are**



DigiCert is a global leader in intelligent trust. We protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. Our AI\-powered DigiCert ONE platform unifies PKI, DNS, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, AI content and agents. Learn why more than 100,000 organizations, including 90% of the Fortune 500, choose DigiCert to stop today's threats and prepare for a quantum\-safe future at www.digicert.com

**Job summary**



DigiCert is looking for a Product Manager to help build the next generation of DNS posture management capabilities for enterprise customers. This role will focus on AI\-enabled DNS products that strengthen security, reliability, performance, automation, and operational insight \- helping redefine DNS as an AI\-native trust layer for the modern Internet.



As a Product Manager, you will own well\-defined product areas within DigiCert's broader DNS roadmap. You will work closely with engineering, architecture, security, ML Ops, product marketing, sales, and customer\-facing teams to translate customer needs, DNS telemetry, and technical capabilities into clear product requirements and measurable outcomes.



This is a hands\-on product role for a builder who can move quickly, use data to make decisions, and partner deeply with technical teams. You will help validate new ideas, prototype posture workflows, define requirements, support launches, and iterate continuously while maintaining enterprise standards for security, reliability, and customer trust.

  


**What you will do**


* Define, prioritize, and deliver AI\-enabled DNS product capabilities within DigiCert's broader DNS roadmap, aligned with the company's trust and cloud strategy.
* Translate customer problems, DNS telemetry, AI/ML capabilities, and market insights into clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and success metrics.
* Partner closely with engineering, architecture, security, and MLOps teams to deliver secure, scalable, cloud\-native DNS services.
* Use AI\-assisted product and prototyping tools to analyze feedback, synthesize insights, explore workflows, and validate ideas early with customers and engineers.
* Develop product capabilities across DNS resolution, traffic management, observability, automation, anomaly detection, posture management, and security use cases.
* Define and track success metrics such as adoption, latency, reliability, automation effectiveness, anomaly\-detection quality, and trust\-signal accuracy.
* Support product\-side GTM execution in partnership with Product Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success, including launch planning, messaging input, enablement, pricing input, and adoption tracking.
* Engage customers, partners, internal field teams, and relevant standards communities to validate use cases and inform roadmap priorities.
* Use telemetry, dashboards, customer feedback, experimentation, and A/B testing where appropriate to guide prioritization and measure product impact.
* Rapidly validate ideas, deliver incremental value, and iterate continuously without compromising security, reliability, performance, or customer trust.

**About the Role:** 




  





 redBus is India's largest online bus ticketing platform, moving millions of travellers across 150,000\+ live routes globally. A meaningful share of our growth now comes from platforms we don't fully control ourselves — B2B2C seller tools, partner APIs, whitelabels, OTAs, and super\-app integrations — where product decisions are inseparable from technical architecture decisions.
 



  





 We are looking for a Technical Product Lead who is equally comfortable writing a crisp PRD and reading an API contract or a data pipeline diagram. This role sits at the intersection of classic product management — roadmaps, prioritisation, stakeholder alignment — and the deeper technical fluency needed to partner credibly with engineering on system design, integrations, and platform scalability. You'll own both the “low\-hanging” product requirements that keep the roadmap moving and the harder technical trade\-offs that determine whether it scales.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**• Product Roadmap Ownership** 




 – Define, prioritise, and execute the product roadmap for partner\-facing and distribution platforms, balancing quick\-win requirements against longer\-horizon technical investments.
 



  





**• Technical Depth in Product Decisions** 




 – Partner directly with engineering on API design, data flow pipelines, and system architecture; be able to evaluate technical trade\-offs (latency, scalability, integration complexity) rather than relying solely on engineering estimates.
 



  





**• Requirement Documentation** 




 – Write PRDs, user stories, API specifications, and wireframes; define clear acceptance criteria and success metrics for every release.
 



  





 •
 **Cross\-Functional \& Partner Collaboration** 




 – Work across engineering, design, sales, partner/BD, CRM, payments, and supplier\-facing teams to align the roadmap within the broader product framework.
 



 – Engage directly with external partners (OTAs, travel platforms, super apps, and aggregators) to curate integration requirements and merchandising offerings.
 



  





**• Data\-Driven Iteration** 




 – Run and analyse A/B tests across web, mobile web, and apps; build dashboards and hypotheses using SQL and product analytics tools to guide decisions.
 



 – Continuously monitor product and platform performance metrics, using them to prioritise the backlog.
 



  





**• Quality, Launch \& Enablement** 




 – Establish acceptance criteria and work with QA to ensure releases meet both business and technical bars before going live.
 



 – Train internal stakeholders (Support, Channel, Field teams) on new features to ensure smooth rollouts.
 



  





**What You Bring:** 




  





 • 1–3 years of experience spanning both software engineering/development and product management —candidates from a strong technical background moving into product, or PMs with genuine hands\-on engineering experience are equally welcome.
 



 • Bachelor's degree in Engineering (B.E./B.Tech); an MBA is a plus but not a substitute for technical depth.
 



 • Working knowledge of APIs, system design fundamentals, and data pipelines — enough to have a substantive technical conversation with engineering, not just consume their output.
 



 • Proficiency in SQL and hands\-on experience with web/app analytics and experimentation tools (Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Hotjar, or similar).
 



 • Hands\-on experience with Agile/Scrum practices — backlog grooming, sprint planning, and PDLC end to end.
 



 • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical constraints into business language and vice versa.
 



 • Business acumen to understand how distribution, partnerships, and platform decisions tie back to revenue and growth.
 



  





**Why This Role:** 




  





 This is a role for someone who doesn't want to choose between being a “product person” and a “technical person.” You'll own real product outcomes — roadmaps, launches, partner relationships — while staying close enough to the architecture to make the calls that matter. If you're energised by both the business “why” and the engineering “how,” we'd love to talk.

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Pocket FM** 




 At our core, we are an AI\-powered entertainment company with a human\-first philosophy: technology should amplify creativity, not replace it. Our proprietary AI works with writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale faster, smarter, and with cultural and emotional integrity.
 



 We move with a startup mindset, curious, fast, and deeply owner\-driven even as we operate at massive scale.
 



  





**About the role** 




 As a Lead Product Manager on the Discovery \& Experience team, you will own one or more product pillars across Recommendations, Search, Personalization, and UX. This is not an execution\-only role. You'll define the problem space, build the roadmap, and drive outcomes with a high degree of autonomy.
 



 You will be the connective tissue between data science, engineering, design, and content, translating user behavior and business goals into crisp, high\-impact product decisions.
 



  





**What you'll own** 




**Recommendations \& Personalization** 



* Own the product roadmap for one or more surfaces: home feed, end\-of\-episode, notifications, or similar
* Define user cohorts and behavioral signals that power contextual, personalized content discovery
* Work with data scientists to specify features, design experiments, and evaluate model performance in product terms
* Track and optimize for listen\-through rate, session depth, and content diversity metrics
* Drive the cold\-start strategy on how new users get value before behavioral history accumulates



**Search** 



* Own the search product end\-to\-end: query understanding, ranking, results UX, and zero\-result recovery
* Define and track search\-specific metrics: search\-to\-play conversion, abandonment rate, query reformulation
* Identify opportunities to incorporate semantic and intent\-based search capabilities
* Run structured experiments to improve relevance and discoverability across the content catalog



**User Experience \& Retention** 



* Map and improve the user journey across key moments: onboarding, first listen, re\-engagement, and churn prevention
* Identify friction using session analytics, funnel analysis, and qualitative user research
* Run continuous A/B experiments on UX hypotheses; build a habit of fast learning and disciplined rollout



  





**Who we're looking for** 



* 6\-9 years in product management, Deep experience in consumer B2C products at scale, audio, video, gaming, social, or content platforms strongly preferred
* Proven track record of owning and shipping ML\-driven personalization or recommendation. Comfortable with ML concepts: collaborative filtering, ranking models, embeddings, bandits, LLM applications in product
* Familiarity with A/B experimentation at scale, you design experiments, read results critically, and build on them
* Can go deep with data scientists on feature engineering and model evaluation, not just a consumer of output
* Experience with experimentation infrastructure: holdouts, CUPED, long\-run tracking, novelty effects
* Strong first\-principles thinker, you question defaults, pressure\-test assumptions, and build from user truth
* High user empathy; you listen deeply, synthesize across qualitative and quantitative signals, and stay close to real behavior
* A taste for simplicity in UX: you know that the best product decisions often feel obvious in hindsight

* Founding team of serial entrepreneurs

 The Junior Product Manager supports the development and deployment of AI\-first learning products within the education ecosystem.

**About The Team**
 smallcase Foundation is the backbone of the entire smallcase ecosystem that powers investment in all smallcases.
   

  

 Were now working on helping Indian investors further diversify their portfolio beyond Indian stocks, ETFs \& REITs by adding mutual funds and global equities to our investment offerings.
   

  

 We're looking for a Product Manager to join us and build this exciting new wave of products with us.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Were looking for a Product Manager to lead the development of core execution rails at smallcase through deep collaboration with external partners.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who combines strong product instincts with excellent stakeholder management and a hands\-on approach to execution.
   

  

 You'll be responsible for defining, building, and shipping products that solve real user problems while advancing key business objectives.
   

  

**What Youll Be Doing**
* Own and drive integrations with key external partners like brokers, RTAs, and infrastructure providers.
* Manage relationships with external stakeholders to ensure alignment, clarity, and timely delivery.
* Create product specs, manage sprint cycles, and work closely with engineering, design, QA, and data teams to build and ship features.
* Collaborate with users, analytics, and support teams to understand user behavior and uncover product insights.
* Contribute to all stages of the product lifecycle from idea to implementation acting as a designer, beta tester, and problem solver.
* Handle multiple projects simultaneously and maintain high standards of execution.


**What We Look For In You**
* 3 to 6 years of product experience of driving integrations with external partners, with strong ownership of end\-to\-end execution.
* Proven ability to manage and deliver integrations involving external stakeholders and technical infrastructure.
* Hands\-on ability to work with APIs (Postman familiarity is a plus) and basic backend concepts.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to align internal and external stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to build wireframes/mockups and translate ideas into user\-first solutions.
* Highly analytical, data\-driven, and user\-centric approach to product decisions.
* Basic understanding of capital markets and market data.


**Nice To Have**
* Familiarity with tools like Mixpanel, tableau etc.
* CFA/FRM certifications or strong domain knowledge in investing or trading.


**About Smallcase**
 At smallcase, we are changing how India invests.
   

  

 smallcase is a leading provider of investment products \& platforms to over 10 million Indians.
   

  

 smallcase was founded in July 2015 by three IIT Kharagpur graduates, Vasanth Kamath, Anugrah Shrivastava and Rohan Gupta.
   

  

 smallcase has been focused on offering innovative investing experiences \& technology.
   

  

 Our platforms are used by over 300 of India's largest financial brands and most respected institutions.
   

  

 We are backed by world\-class investors including top\-tier funds, institutions and operators from the capital markets space who believe in our mission of enabling better financial futures for every Indian.
   

  

**Life At Smallcase**
 We are not just building a business, we are making a long\-lasting impact both in the wealth \& assets landscape with our unique technology \& expanding ecosystem.
   

  

 Over the last 11 years, our team, products, and platforms have grown and so have our ambitions.
   

  

 Innovation remains at the heart of what we do.
   

  

 Our other core values are transparency, integrity \& long\-term thinking.
   

  

 Our key asset has always been our people, and we empower individuals to build and do some of the best work in their lifetimes at smallcase.
   

  

 Flexibility, ownership and constant feedback loops are some of the ways we keep evolving the working environment.

 Product execution

 User research and analysis
   

  

* Gather insights from users, stakeholders, and data to identify opportunities.
* Track feature performance and recommend improvements based on user behaviour.
* Conduct competitor research and stay current on market trends.


 Collaboration and delivery
   

  

* Work closely with design, engineering, marketing, and operations to launch new features.
* Coordinate testing, QA, and product releases.
* Communicate product updates and align stakeholders throughout the development process.


**What You Bring**
 Curiosity, rigour, and the drive to ship
   

  

**Required**

 NON\-NEGOTIABLES

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About The Role**
 redBus is India's largest online bus ticketing platform, moving millions of travellers across 150,000\+ live routes globally. A meaningful share of our growth now comes from platforms we don't fully control ourselves — B2B2C seller tools, partner APIs, whitelabels, OTAs, and super\-app integrations — where product decisions are inseparable from technical architecture decisions.
   

  

 We are looking for a Technical Product Lead who is equally comfortable writing a crisp PRD and reading an API contract or a data pipeline diagram. This role sits at the intersection of classic product management — roadmaps, prioritisation, stakeholder alignment — and the deeper technical fluency needed to partner credibly with engineering on system design, integrations, and platform scalability. You'll own both the “low\-hanging” product
   

  

 requirements that keep the roadmap moving and the harder technical trade\-offs that determine whether it scales.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Product Roadmap Ownership


 – Define, prioritise, and execute the product roadmap for partner\-facing and distribution platforms, balancing quick\-win requirements against longer\-horizon technical investments.
   

  

* Technical Depth in Product Decisions


 – Partner directly with engineering on API design, data flow pipelines, and system architecture; be able to evaluate technical trade\-offs (latency, scalability, integration complexity) rather than relying solely on engineering estimates.
   

  

* Requirement Documentation


 – Write PRDs, user stories, API specifications, and wireframes; define clear acceptance criteria and success metrics for every release.
   

  

* Cross\-Functional \& Partner Collaboration


 – Work across engineering, design, sales, partner/BD, CRM, payments, and supplier\-facing teams to align the roadmap within the broader product framework.
   

  

 – Engage directly with external partners (OTAs, travel platforms, super apps, and aggregators) to curate integration requirements and merchandising offerings.
   

  

* Data\-Driven Iteration


 – Run and analyse A/B tests across web, mobile web, and apps; build dashboards and hypotheses using SQL and product analytics tools to guide decisions.
   

  

 – Continuously monitor product and platform performance metrics, using them to prioritise the backlog.
   

  

* Quality, Launch \& Enablement


 – Establish acceptance criteria and work with QA to ensure releases meet both business and technical bars before going live.
   

  

 – Train internal stakeholders (Support, Channel, Field teams) on new features to ensure smooth rollouts.
   

  

**What You Bring**
* 1–3 years of experience spanning both software engineering/development and product management — candidates from a strong technical background moving into product, or PMs with genuine hands\-on engineering experience, are equally welcome.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering (B.E./B.Tech); an MBA is a plus but not a substitute for technical depth.
* Working knowledge of APIs, system design fundamentals, and data pipelines — enough to have a substantive technical conversation with engineering, not just consume their output.
* Proficiency in SQL and hands\-on experience with web/app analytics and experimentation tools (Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Hotjar, or similar).
* Hands\-on experience with Agile/Scrum practices — backlog grooming, sprint planning, and PDLC end to end.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical constraints into business language and vice versa.
* Business acumen to understand how distribution, partnerships, and platform decisions tie back to revenue and growth.


**Why This Role**
 This is a role for someone who doesn't want to choose between being a “product person” and a “technical person.” You'll own real product outcomes — roadmaps, launches, partner relationships — while staying close enough to the architecture to make the calls that matter. If you're energised by both the business “why” and the engineering “how,” we'd love to talk.

jobs.title: Software Architect
jobs.description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high\-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling, and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

  



Could you be the full\-time Software Architect in Bangalore we’re looking for?

 **Your future role**



Take on a new challenge and apply your technical leadership and software architecture expertise in a cutting\-edge field. You’ll work alongside a highly motivated and collaborative team.



You'll shape the future of embedded software systems, ensuring their performance, safety, and reliability. Day\-to\-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (product development, quality, and safety teams), lead the design of software architecture, and oversee software lifecycle processes, and much more.



You’ll specifically take care of defining software requirements and architecture, as well as leading integration and validation processes, but also contribute to the development of innovative solutions for the rail mobility industry.



We’ll look to you for:


* Contributing to product/system specification and architecture in collaboration with product architects and owners
* Defining software requirements, including functional, operational, interface, and performance constraints
* Designing software architecture, breaking down components, and allocating requirements
* Making key technical decisions, such as selecting tools, methodologies, and microprocessor platforms
* Leading software and hardware integration, as well as preparing and performing tests
* Driving innovation by creating reusable codes, reference libraries, and model\-based developments
  


  

**All about you**



We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:


* Bachelor’s or postgraduate degree in Engineering – IT, CS, ECE, EEE, or equivalent
* 15\+ years of experience in product and software development, preferably in complex embedded systems
* Proficiency in programming languages such as C\#, Rust, Python, and microservices development
* Experience with RTOS (Linux, VX Works) or equivalent
* Knowledge of containerization tools like Docker and Kubernetes
* Understanding of Ethernet protocols such as TCP/IP
* Familiarity with standards such as CENELEC SIL4 / DO178A / DO178B
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills
* Analytical and strategic thinking with the ability to make data\-driven decisions
* Flair for learning technologies specific to the railway domain
  


  

**Things you’ll enjoy** Join us on a life\-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:


* Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long\-term career free from boring daily routines
* Work with new security standards for rail signalling
* Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues
* Contribute to innovative projects
* Utilise our flexible and inclusive working environment
* Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
* Benefit from our investment in your development, through award\-winning learning
* Progress towards senior leadership or technical expert roles
* Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension)

  



You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

  

**Important to note**



As a global business, we’re an equal\-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

  

  

**Job Segment:** Embedded, Product Development, Developer, Linux, Technology, Research

Position: Consultant Data Loss Prevention (DLP) Analyst  

Location: Bangalore  

Shift: General  

Experience: Around 3–5\+ years in Cyber Security, Information Security, Security Operations, Data Protection, or a related technical discipline  

  

POSITION DESCRIPTION  

The Data Loss Prevention (DLP) Analyst is part of CGI's Global Security Operations Centre (GSOC), which provides enterprise wide security monitoring, threat detection, incident response, and data protection services across the organisation.  

The DLP Analyst is responsible for monitoring, analysing, and investigating Data Loss Prevention (DLP) events to identify and mitigate risks relating to the unauthorised disclosure, misuse, or loss of sensitive information. Working closely with Security Monitoring, Incident Response, Insider Threat, Security Engineering, and business stakeholders, the role supports the protection of CGI's information assets while enabling secure business operations.  

The DLP Analyst is responsible for investigating DLP alerts, validating policy violations, identifying malicious or accidental data loss, and coordinating appropriate response activities. In addition, the role contributes to the ongoing development and optimisation of CGI's DLP capabilities by improving policies, reducing false positives, supporting new technology deployments, and ensuring data protection controls remain effective.  

This role requires a strong understanding of data protection principles, cybersecurity, cloud services, Microsoft 365, endpoint technologies, and modern collaboration platforms. The successful candidate will possess excellent analytical and investigative skills, demonstrate sound judgement when assessing risk, and effectively communicate technical findings to both technical and non technical stakeholders.

The following are the key responsibilities related to this role:  

  

. Monitor and investigate Data Loss Prevention (DLP) alerts across endpoint, email, cloud, and collaboration platforms.  

. Analyse DLP events to determine whether activity represents accidental data exposure, policy violations, insider threats, or malicious exfiltration.  

. Conduct investigations into suspected data loss incidents, documenting findings and recommending appropriate remediation actions.  

. Work closely with Incident Response, Security Monitoring, Insider Threat, Legal, HR, Privacy, and business teams during investigations where appropriate.  

. Escalate confirmed security incidents in accordance with established incident response procedures.  

. Develop, maintain, and optimise DLP policies to improve detection accuracy while reducing false positives.

. Contribute to the continuous improvement of DLP processes, playbooks, and operational procedures.  

. Support user awareness initiatives by identifying common data handling issues and recommending improvements to security awareness programmes.  

. Maintain awareness of emerging threats, data protection regulations, and industry best practices.  

. Ensure activities are conducted in accordance with organisational policies, regulatory obligations, and recognised security frameworks.  

. Support user awareness initiatives by identifying common data handling issues and recommending improvements to security awareness programmes.

. Experience investigating security alerts or data protection events in an enterprise environment.  

. Good understanding of Data Loss Prevention (DLP) concepts, information classification, and data protection principles.  

. Knowledge of common data exfiltration techniques, insider threats, and information security risks.  

. Experience developing DLP policies, tuning detection rules, and reducing false positives.  

. Strong analytical and investigative skills with the ability to assess business risk and prioritise appropriately.  

. Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**Functional Job** **Title :** **Billing Transformation –Business Analyst (Data Hub) – Senior Associate**

**Reports** **to :** **BTP AVP/Sr. Manager**

**Department/** **Division** **: Controllership, Bangalore/Hyderabad**

**Background:**


State Street has established a Global Billing Function under Controllership, which is responsible for client billing set up and invoicing across all business lines and geographies globally at State Street. Organizationally, it combines all groups performing these activities globally, and also includes centers residing in State Street Shared Service locations in Poland, India and China. Billing Organization owns aspects of business\-as\-usual activities within billing areas and also drives process improvements and automation. Global Billing Function is in the process of migrating to a new technology platform which will be used for all business units and regions.

**Basic Purpose of Job:**


The Billing application Data Hub Business Analyst will support the business and perform following activities. the non\-PROD Billing application Related Data Hub Activities ( for BUAT and other related purposes).


They will perform the following functions:

* Analyze and validate new business requirements for various platforms used by State Street for Billing function.
* Coordinate with requirement owners to understand and build the BRD’s for the Test Case Scenario.
* Attend Demo's from QA and raise issues if there are any gaps.
* Build test case for the scenarios which is part of enhancement (Release)
* Support various product enhancements and improvements for production release milestone
* Document procedures and checklists to control activities and report status
* Support process improvement to enable increase velocity in all related processes
* Perform day to day activities of identified as part of Billing Transformation Program
* BUAT Test case Execution and Evidence documentation.
* BUAT Test case Execution for Downstream Scenarios (GAO \& Data Hub)
* Perform the Billing Application setups that are needed in the Non prod instances as part of BUAT support.

**Work Experiences:**

* Bachelor’s/Master’s Degree in Finance, 5\-9 years of progressive experience preferably from Financial Services and Banking industry / institutions.
* Experience of writing BRD’s, Test cases and execution of test scenarios.
* Complex operational activities involving analysis of financial data
* Knowledge on business or technical migration/conversion processes will be an added advantage
* Experience of Oracle Revenue Management and Billing (ORMB) application an advantage
* Variance analysis of reference and financial data and reporting of insights

**Skills:**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite (Excel, Access, PowerPoint, Word, Visio), advance levels of Excel (pivot tables, formulas, excel workbook maintenance best practices), SQL experience
* Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interface effectively with individuals at various levels, both internal and external
* Analytical, with strong problem\-solving abilities and creative resolution skills
* Ability to work on multiple topics in a fast\-paced, high volume environment
* Strong Analytical skill set used for financial data comparisons, reconciliations and investigations
* Ability to remain organized, pay strict attention to detail, and meet critical deadlines within program schedule
* Detailed orientated with ability to consistently and accurately execute against operational processes and controls
* Ability to adapt to a changing environment and demands of transition of new clients
* Strong communication skills with ability to participate in or lead conference calls and present financial results to financial and non\-financial audiences at various levels of seniority
* Pride of ownership with the ability to drive results within the Business
* Solid business knowledge as it relates to the financial services industry including Financial product and institution knowledge
* Self\-motivated, self\-assured, and self\-managed

**About State Street**
======================


Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.


We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work\-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**
 Serve as a business analyst within a hybrid work model translating complex business needs into scalable digital solutions using SQL Java Springboot microservices JavaScript PL or SQL on mySQL and AWS services. Collaborate with cross functional stakeholders to deliver secure reliable and efficient applications that advance enterprise goals and create meaningful value for end users.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Analyze business processes and requirements in detail to define clear functional and nonfunctional specifications that guide design of scalable solutions using SQL Java and microservice patterns on Springboot and AWS services.
* Collaborate with product owners and business stakeholders to prioritize backlogs refine user stories and acceptance criteria and ensure that each increment delivers measurable value to customers and the organization.
* Document end to end process flows data mappings and system interaction diagrams that clearly explain how PL or SQL on mySQL Java services JavaScript front ends and AWS components work together to support business outcomes.
* Coordinate with engineering teams to translate requirements into technical tasks clarify edge cases and validate that database logic Java and JavaScript implementations align with expected behavior and performance goals.
* Perform detailed data analysis using SQL and PL or SQL on mySQL to identify patterns validate data quality support decision making and proactively highlight data related risks or gaps in existing solutions.
* Support design and review of Springboot microservices by defining interface contracts payload structures and error handling scenarios that improve interoperability resilience and maintainability.
* Work closely with quality engineering teams to define test strategies create test scenarios based on user journeys and verify that functional behavior integrations and data transformations meet requirements.
* Facilitate workshops and walkthroughs with cross functional partners to present solution options explain technical trade offs in accessible terms and secure alignment on chosen approaches and delivery timelines.
* Use AWS capabilities such as managed databases messaging and compute services in collaboration with architects to propose solution patterns that improve scalability security and cost effectiveness for business services.
* Prepare clear user documentation release notes and training material that help business teams adopt new features quickly and reduce dependency on technical teams for routine operational queries.
* Monitor production issues and incident trends in partnership with support teams analyze root causes in microservices SQL logic or JavaScript flows and recommend backlog items that strengthen stability and user satisfaction.
* Apply structured delivery practices and agile ceremonies within the hybrid work model by planning sprints tracking progress and maintaining transparent communication channels with on site and remote stakeholders.
* Contribute to continuous improvement by recommending data driven enhancements automation opportunities and reusable solution patterns that advance the company technology strategy and deliver positive impact for society.


**Qualifications**
* Demonstrate strong proficiency in SQL and PL or SQL on mySQL with the ability to design queries optimize performance and interpret complex data sets to support analytical and transactional use cases.
* Bring hands on experience in Java and Springboot based microservices including design of REST interfaces integration patterns and application of secure coding and modular design principles.
* Possess solid practical knowledge of JavaScript for user interface interactions validation logic and integration with backend services in modern web applications.
* Show proven exposure to AWS cloud services relevant to application hosting data storage and messaging while understanding shared responsibility concepts and cost aware design considerations.
* Exhibit six to nine years of experience as a business analyst or similar role in technology driven environments with a track record of converting business goals into actionable technical requirements.
* Communicate effectively with both technical and business audiences using clear language structured documentation and collaborative problem solving approaches within diverse teams in a hybrid work setup.

* Basic knowledge in ABAP development and ABAP dictionary

* Well versed on application lifecycles – particularly concerning the transport of roles \& privileges from DEV to PROD and potential impacts of Support/Enhancement Packages
* Strong understanding of the SAP software toolset and familiar with SAP Systems concepts, practices, and procedures
* Fluent in English language (e.g. French, German, Italian, Spanish, etc.)
